videos.caption: Crispy Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo Pasta 🔥🤌🏼 recipe ⬇️ 2 chicken breasts, sliced in half (season with salt & pepper) 2 eggs 1 cup flour (season with salt & pepper 2 cups seasoned breadcrumbs or use panko and season with salt, Italian seasoning, garlic & onion powder 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Slice chicken breasts in half. Place in a ziplock bag or plastic wrap. Pound with anything heavy until super thin. Dip in flour with salt & pepper, then in egg and finally in breadcrumbs/panko. Press down so the breading sticks. Thoroughly spray with oil and air fry 380F for 7-8 min. Immediately sprinkle salt over fried chicken. Alfredo Sauce Pasta of choice 4 tbsp butter 4 garlic cloves, minced 2 cups heavy cream 1/3 cup parmesan cheese, shredded 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning Salt & pepper to taste 2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped Season your shrimp and cook on medium high heat for 2-3 minutes, or until color changes. Remove from the pan. Melt butter on medium heat. Add garlic cloves and mix until fragrant. Pour heavy cream and season with Italian seasoning, salt & pepper. Let this simmer for a few minutes before lowering the heat & shredding Parmesan over top. Once thickened, add al dente pasta, shrimp & parsley. Add pasta water as needed. #pasta #alfredo #chicken #crispychicken #chickencutlet #alfredosauce

Chicken au poivre.  I can’t get over how good this was. 100/100. This has definitely been added to my weekly rotation 🤤 Ingredients Chicken 4-5 chicken thighs 1 tsp black pepper  ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (optional) 1/2 tsp dried thyme (optional) 1 tbsp olive oil Creamy Pepper Sauce 1/2 white onion, very finely chopped 3 garlic cloves minced  2 tbsp crushed peppercorns  1/4 tsp rosemary  150 ml chicken stock 100 ml double cream 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1 tbsp butter Salt, to taste Extra crushed black pepper, if needed Parsley chopped  Crispy Baby Potatoes baby potatoes 1–1½ tbsp olive oil Salt Black pepper 1/4 tsp dried thyme  1/4 tsp rosemary 1 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp garlic Method  Potatoes Groove the baby potatoes with a wedge cutter. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and herbs. Air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes, shake, then 200°C for 5–8 minutes. Add butter and crushed garlic for the last 2–3 minutes. Chicken Pat the thighs dry and apply the prepared seasoning. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove and rest. Pepper Sauce In the same pan, add 1 tbsp butter and finely chopped white onion and garlic. Cook for 2–3 minutes. Add in the crushed peppercorns, add the chicken stock, scrape the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes. Add the mustard, Worcestershire sauce and rosemary. Stir in the double cream, simmer for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. Return the chicken to the sauce for 1–2 minutes. Sprinkle chopped parsley if using.  (Adjust all seasonings to your preference) #dinnerideas #chickendinnerideas #EasyRecipes #easydinner #homecooking

LOOK IDENTITY — AETHER NOMAD 9099 🛸🤎🤍🩶 📍 Date officielle de naissance du look : 22.08.9099 Un look imaginé pour une époque où la mode ne cherche plus à suivre le futur… elle vient directement de lui. Le pantalon cargo à double ceinture signé @flyerrer.official conserve l’ADN street des années 90/2000, mais ici, il est propulsé dans une autre dimension. Taille volontairement abaissée, volumes XXL, poches cargo, nuances beige poussière et chocolat : la silhouette semble avoir été retrouvée dans une archive venue de 9099. Cette fois, le haut change complètement l’histoire. La maille zippée à col montant et ses détails effet fourrure construisent une silhouette plus sculpturale, plus mystérieuse, presque extraterrestre. Sa palette claire dialogue parfaitement avec le pantalon et crée un contraste entre douceur, puissance et futurisme. Les deux ceintures deviennent une véritable signature visuelle. Les sneakers massives ancrent le look dans le présent, tandis que les lunettes futuristes et le chapeau que j’ai imaginé transportent l’ensemble bien au-delà de notre époque. 🕶️🛸 Et le plus important ? Je n’ai pas simplement assemblé des vêtements. J’ai construit une identité. La façon de porter chaque pièce, les proportions, les accessoires, les matières et l’attitude ont été pensés pour créer une silhouette que l’on remarque avant même de comprendre pourquoi. Aujourd’hui, les gens tournent la tête. Ils demandent des photos. Ils cherchent à comprendre. En 9099, ils chercheront probablement à comprendre d’où cette archive est arrivée. ⚡️ Conseil de style : Ne cherche pas à porter ce que tout le monde porte. Cherche à créer quelque chose que les autres n’ont encore jamais vu. La mode devient puissante lorsqu’elle ne demande pas : « Est-ce que ça plaît ? » Elle demande : « Est-ce que ça va rester dans leur mémoire ? » Un vrai look ne suit pas l’époque. Il lui donne quelque chose à rattraper. 🛸🤎🤍🩶🕶️ @flyerrer.official 🖤 @_startexceedend_ 🤍 #aethernomad9099

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. Chicken Francese…tried it for the first time in NY last year and fell in LOVE. This is my take ok? Also, might have done some false advertising with under 20 min but def under 30. Ingredients: * 2 large chicken breasts. * 2 eggs. * 1.5 tbsp milk or cream. * 1/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano. * 2.5 tsp aleppo pepper. * 2 (1 just for the zest, 1/2 kept whole, and half cut into wheels and then halved). * 1/2 cup white wine. * 16 oz chicken broth. * 1 shallot (brunoise). * 1 large garlic clove (minced). * 1/4 cup parsley. * 2 tbsp chives (more for topping). * 5 tbsp unsalted butter. * 1 tsp soy sauce. * 1/4 cup flour. * salt and pepper to taste. Directions: 1. Butterfly the chicken breasts, then pound until desired level of thickness. 2. Whisk the eggs, add in 1 tsp aleppo pepper, the parm, milk and some seasoned salt. 3. Season your flour as well with salt and pepper. 4. Preheat a pan on high for 2 min. Add plenty of olive oil and lower to medium high. 5. Pat dry the chicken breasts, pass them through the egg wash. 6. Fry the chicken breasts on medium high until golden on both sides, about 2-3 min per side. 7. In another pan, preheat for 2 min as well. Add a bit of olive oil and the halved lemon wheels. Let them caramelize for about 2-3 min per side and remove. 8. On medium heat, add in the shallot and garlic. Deglaze with the wine and let it reduce by half. Add in chicken broth, lemon zest and soy sauce. Let it simmer until reduced by half. Should be like 8-10 min.  9. Squeeze in juice of 1/2 lemon, add aleppo pepper and herbs. Cook together for 2 more min. Turn heat off, add the butter and emulsify. 10. Serve the chicken with the sauce, more chives, the charred lemons and black pepper. #chicken #chickencutlet #chickenrecipes #chickenfrancese #dinner

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chipotlechicken #highprotein #mealprep #healthyrecipes

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Marry Me Chicken Tortellini is an easy and delicious dinner recipe the whole family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts, sliced into cubes  1/2 cup of flour  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder  2 TBSP olive oil 2 TBSP butter 2 TBSP of minced garlic 1 cup of chicken broth 1 cup of heavy cream 1 cup of Parmesan cheese 1 tsp of red pepper flakes  1/2 tsp each of oregano and thyme  1/3 cup of chopped sun dried tomatoes 19 oz bag of frozen tortellini  INSTRUCTIONS Mix together flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Dredge chicken breasts into the flour/seasoning mixture.   In a skillet heat olive oil and butter on medium heat. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and it reaches 165 degrees.  Take the chicken out of the skillet and put aside.  Add minced garlic, sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth to the skillet. Lower heat and add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir well.  Add the red pepper flakes, oregano, and thyme. Stir together well and let simmer until it starts to slightly thicken (this could take at least five minutes).  Add one bag of frozen tortellini, cover, and let cook for a few minutes. The tortellini will also help thicken the sauce. Once tortellini is tender add chicken back to the skillet and serve. Enjoy! *This is a little bit spicy with 1 tsp of red pepper flakes, for less heat use 1/4 tsp!  #dinner #chicken #recipes

Clean and trim the chicken, then marinate with all marinade ingredients for at least 3 hours. 2. Mix the batter ingredients, coat the chicken evenly, and let it rest for 5 minutes. 3. Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then stir in the soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, and MSG (if using). Simmer until the sauce is glossy. 5. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal
